title: Refill Cycle and the Days Divisor for Member-Filed Quantity Limit Exception Requests
content:
Under the Utilization Management Program, the quantity per rolling 30 days that a member-filed first-time quantity limit exception request asks for is the prescription's quantity per fill multiplied by 30 and divided by a number of days, and those days follow the refill cycle the member is on at the Home Delivery Pharmacy (Northbridge Rx Home Delivery).

**Rule.**

- A member **enrolled in automatic home delivery refills** whose prescription is written for **more than a 34-day supply** has the prescription's days supply less the home delivery program's automatic refill lead days as the divisor, because an automatic refill is placed when that many days of supply remain.
- A member **not enrolled in automatic refills** who had **at least 3 home delivery shipments of the drug in the last six months** has the prescription's days supply times the home delivery program's refill eligibility fraction as the divisor, because such a member refills as soon as a refill becomes eligible.
- **Every other member** has the prescription's days supply as the divisor.

The prescription's days supply is the days supply per fill of the newest Home Delivery Pharmacy prescription for the drug or, where the member holds none and the most recent paid retail fill stands in for it, that fill's days supply. The shipments counted are shipped Home Delivery Pharmacy orders of the drug; the last six months are the months ending on the filing date, a shipment counting when its order is dated after the same day of the month six months before the filing date. The automatic refill enrollment, the lead days and the eligibility fraction are those of the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy account and program.

## Condition table

| Automatic refills | Days supply per fill | Shipments of the drug in the last six months | Divisor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enrolled | more than 34 | any | days supply less the automatic refill lead days |
| Enrolled | 34 or fewer | any | days supply |
| Not enrolled | any | 3 or more | days supply times the refill eligibility fraction |
| Not enrolled | any | 0, 1 or 2 | days supply |

## Illustration (hypothetical program figures: lead days 10, eligibility fraction 0.75)

A prescription for 27 tablets per 90-day fill:

- enrolled in automatic refills: divisor 90 less 10, that is 80; 27 multiplied by 30 and divided by 80 gives 10.125;
- not enrolled, 3 shipments in the last six months: divisor 90 times 0.75, that is 67.5; 27 multiplied by 30 and divided by 67.5 gives 12;
- not enrolled, 2 shipments: divisor 90; 27 multiplied by 30 and divided by 90 gives 9.

A prescription for exactly 34 days supply is not more than a 34-day supply, so an enrolled member's divisor stays the 34 days.
